description: Create a Suno task on RunAPI (convert audio). Returns a task id, status, and output URLs.

callback_url.description: Webhook URL for async notifications. Declared type: string.

source_audio_id.description: Audio id within the source Task, or a RunAPI audio resource id returned by a previous request. Declared type: string.

source_task_id.description: RunAPI Task id that produced the audio. Required when the audio id alone does not identify the source. Declared type: string.

wait.description: Poll until the task reaches a terminal status.

name: convert_audio
